backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing student management system with role-based access control, user profiles, student records, marks tracking, attendance recording, and subject management using Map and List data structures.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old actor state to new state by adding a subjects map pre-populated with 21 German school subjects (Biologie, Chemie, Deutsch, etc.).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four high-confidence features: marks recording with subject selection, admin subject management interface, attendance updates, and role-based UI rendering.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes with education-focused theme colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Tarun Coaching Center Student Tracker application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, students, marks, attendance, subjects, and login pages, plus authentication flow and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Guard component that checks authentication and admin permissions, displaying appropriate error messages or redirecting non-admin users away from restricted content.
frontend/src/components/AttendanceForm.t: Form component for recording student attendance with date, student ID, and present/absent toggle. Restricted to admin users only and includes alerts about daily updates and manual student ID entry.
frontend/src/components/AttendanceHistor: Displays a student's attendance history with statistics (attendance rate, total/present/absent days) and a scrollable list of recent records. Shows loading states and empty states when no student is selected or no records exist.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with navigation header, logo, role-based menu items (including admin-only Subjects link), user profile display, and logout functionality. Includes responsive mobile menu and authentication-based rendering.
frontend/src/components/MarkForm.tsx: Form component for adding student marks with student ID, subject dropdown (from backend), exam type, and score fields. Admin-only access with alerts about automatic updates and manual student ID entry.
frontend/src/components/MarksHistory.tsx: Displays student marks grouped by subject with grade badges (A+ to F) and performance trend icons. Shows loading and empty states appropriately.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup requiring name and role selection (Teacher/Administrator/Staff). Cannot be dismissed until profile is saved.
frontend/src/components/StudentForm.tsx: A form component for adding new students with fields for name, roll number, grade, and contact, using the useAddStudent mutation hook and resetting form state on success.
frontend/src/components/SubjectManagemen: Admin-only component for managing test subjects, allowing users to add new subjects and edit existing ones with inline editing functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Convenience hook that combines Internet Identity authentication state with user profile and admin status queries to provide a unified authentication interface.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling login/logout flows, identity persistence, and authentication status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, students, subjects, marks, and attendance, with toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for theming, defining color schemes for light and dark modes using oklch color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Page component for attendance management with authentication guard, displaying forms for recording attendance and viewing attendance history in a two-column layout.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero banner with user greeting and three feature cards (Student Management, Marks Tracking, Attendance Records) linking to respective sections. Redirects unauthenticated users to login.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with Internet Identity authentication, displaying branding and a login button. Handles authentication errors and redirects authenticated users to home.
frontend/src/pages/MarksPage.tsx: Marks management page with two-column layout containing a MarkForm for recording marks and MarksHistory for viewing student performance. Requires authentication.
frontend/src/pages/StudentsPage.tsx: Student management page with search functionality and admin-only add student dialog. Displays alert noting missing backend methods (getAllStudents, updateStudent, deleteStudent) preventing full implementation.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectsPage.tsx: Subject management page that renders the SubjectManagement component for adding and managing test subjects. Requires authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and parameter cleanup functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, custom fonts (Inter, Poppins), container queries, typography plugin, and animation utilities for accordions.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for a student marks and attendance application for Tarun Coaching Center. Contains architectural notes, existing features (student records, marks, attendance, test subject management), and role-based access control with admin-only update capabilities.
